info.title: UplinkSwitch API
info.summary: One key and one base URL for Claude, GPT, Gemini and the open-weight models in the OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini wire formats, plus image, video, speech and 3D models.
info.description:
Send the request your SDK already sends, to `https://api.uplinkswitch.com/v1` instead of the developer's URL. The proxy changes only the credential, `stream_options.include_usage` on OpenAI-format streams that did not set it, a `top_k` of 0 or less (off) which it leaves out, and the model id when the request named one of your aliases.

Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer sk-uplink-live-...`, or the header your SDK sends (`x-api-key` for the Anthropic SDK, `x-goog-api-key` for the Gemini SDK). Exactly one key per request, never in the URL.

Model ids are enumerated by GET /v1/catalog (chat) and GET /v1/catalog/media (media), with prices, and by GET /v1/models for what a given key may call. They are not listed in this document.

Errors: every error is a JSON object whose `error` carries a `code` and a `message`. OpenAI-format routes and every route outside the chat formats add `type` and `param` (the `Error` schema); the Anthropic format answers in Anthropic's error shape with the code appended to the message, and the Gemini format in Google's. Every error carries `x-uplink-request-id`.

Every response carries `x-uplink-request-id`; quote it when you write in. Chat responses add `x-uplink-model` and, when they apply, the headers under `components.headers`.
